question: To which Hindustani music Gharana are the Gundecha brothers related?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dagari Gharana**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Gundecha brothers, Umakant and Ramakant, are associated with the **Dagarvani dhrupad Gharana** style of Hindustani classical music
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Known for
 Dhrupad vocalists
 
 

 Gharana
 Dagarvani dhrupad
 
 

 Awards
 Padma Shri in 2012
 
 

 Other accomplishments
 Founded the Gurukul Dhrupad Sansthan in Bhopal
 
 
 
 
 
• Dhrupad is the oldest form of north Indian classical music.
 
• The Gundecha brothers were leading exponents of the style and were active performers in India and internationally.
 
• They were also known for their contributions to the field of Indian classical music. 
 
• After Ramakant Gundecha's death in 2019, his son Anant began performing with Umakant in the Gundecha bandhu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agra Gharana:**

 
 
• The Agra gharana is renowned for its intricate and complex rhythms (taals) and intricate melodic patterns.
 
• Singers from this gharana often blend elements of both the dhrupad and khayal styles in their performances.
 
• Famous singers from this gharana include Fayyaz Khan and Khadim Hussain Khan.
 
 
 
• **Indore Gharana:**
 
 
• The Indore gharana is known for its melodious and soothing style of singing.
 
• Singers from this gharana excel in conveying emotions through their music.
 
• Famous singers from this gharana include Ustad Alla Rakha Khan and Ustad Amanat Ali Khan.
 
 
 
• **Patiala Gharana:**
 
 
• The Patiala gharana is characterized by its energetic and powerful performances.
 
• Singers from this gharana place a strong emphasis on rhythm and tempo in their music.
 
• Famous singers from this gharana include Bade Ghulam Ali Khan and Malika Pukhraj.
